metadata.description: Portal-agnostic agentic skills for working with published single-cell atlases and the literature behind them. Each skill installs on its own.

plugins.name: remote-h5ad-obs
plugins.description: Read the per-cell obs table out of a remote h5ad over HTTP range requests, without downloading the expression matrix.

plugins.name: author-annotation-columns
plugins.description: Find which obs columns hold the authors' own cell-type, tissue, developmental-stage and disease annotations, as opposed to the portal's standardised fields, cluster indices and QC.

plugins.name: paper-access
plugins.description: Retrieve a list of papers as tagged article XML where it can be had, probe how much of each one a search index holds, and say honestly which papers nobody can reach.

plugins.name: ontology-mapping
plugins.description: Map species, sex, developmental stage, disease and tissue strings onto NCBITaxon, PATO, HsapDv, MONDO and UBERON for human atlases, using the sample's age and sex to decide the tissue term, and refusing rather than guessing.

plugins.name: atlas-tools
plugins.description: Convenience bundle: both h5ad plugins together. Carries no skills of its own.
